provenance.method: MP4 and poster URLs are present in the official Nu about page HTML; downloads are public CDN resources without authentication or DRM. No YouTube download, trimming, transcoding or synthetic imagery.
provenance.copyright_note: Public accessibility and an official host are provenance evidence, not an assertion of an open license. Copyright remains with Nu/Nubank.

visual_review.observations: Actual frames show speakers in Nu offices, with a visible Nu mark in the background; clean 1920×1080 source. Short 11.97-second corporate clip; not a technical case-study evidence video.

integration.reduced_motion: Use the poster until an explicit play action; do not force motion.
